Sometime before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yuon Par]] led an '''expedition''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros]], known more commonly as [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teta/Legends|Teta]], for the purpose of conducting [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] excavations.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The expedition to Koros was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''{{'s}} entry on Yuon Par.
